children: Chemung Financial completed its subsidiary's conversion to a national bank under OCC supervision.
Chemung Canal Trust Company converted from a NY-chartered trust company to a national bank on Oct 1, 2026.
Following conversion the bank will operate as Chemung Canal Trust Company, National Association under OCC oversight.
The bank remains the same corporate entity and structure despite the change in charter and regulator.
